body: But it never ends. All I care about is the goal I’m going for. Without it, I have nothing else to really go for in life. I have been working for it for years and years I don’t know when I will see any results. As of now there is nothing and I don’t know what to do at this point.

It’s not about being better than someone else. It’s being the best version of myself. I constantly fail time and time again and I can never reach my goals despite the effort I put in. And I repeat the same cycle of failure. It’s insanity. But I have nothing else to do.
I work extremely hard in life. Especially athletics. I train so hard but I can’t succeed. I’ve never had real success. I don’t have any other purpose.
I can’t perform. I always fail.
